system.description:
Your Shinobi Instrument acts as a passive shield against sound. When you would make a saving throw to resist the effects of a Genjutsu cast against you with the Auditory keyword, your Shinobi Instrument automatically spends 1 Resonance, to grant you advantage on this save.

Additionally, if you succeed, you treat your success as if you critically succeeded instead, if possible.
